title: South Wales grid, by the half hour
summary: Region 7 cut of DS-001 with the generation mix pivoted to columns, for the notebook’s local questions.

schema.description: As DS-001; regional, so forecast only.

schema.field: mix_gas, mix_wind, mix_solar, mix_nuclear, mix_biomass, mix_imports, mix_hydro, mix_coal, mix_other

limits: A view, not a new source
DS-002 is DS-001 filtered to regionid = 7. Every limit of DS-001 applies.
query:
SELECT time, intensity_forecast, intensity_index
FROM   sample
WHERE  region = 'sw' AND day = '2026-09-29'
ORDER  BY intensity_forecast LIMIT 5;
queryNote: The five cleanest half hours of the notebook’s Monday.
revisions: v1 · first release, as a view of DS-001.
